title: Wikipedia Clickstream

year_evidence: OfficialMeta canonicalcitation ElleryWulczyn,DarioTaraborelli(2015), WikipediaClickstream plus January2015 release entry.
author: sasakiy84
scope: Native master-based editablePPTX, matching finalPDF, actual official2026-09 jawiki monthly data.4 main article examples and5 additional independent article examples; no Gemini/external generation API/model benchmark evaluation.
